evidence_policy.observed_basis: These are recurring information-design problems identified from common document and interface structures, not claims of field research.
evidence_policy.research_completed: Task-contract review and DSL capability review only; no interviews, usability tests, local-policy verification, or real customer data collection.
evidence_policy.demonstration_rule: All brands, people, listings, bills, assignments, policies, appliances, city rules, meeting items, floor plans, and measurements are fictional unless explicitly stated otherwise. Every artwork must carry a visible 'Fictional demo' label.
evidence_policy.future_evidence: Each case records a validation question so an executor can later replace demo content with verified local or user evidence without changing the core information structure.

research_claim_boundary: All ten problems are design hypotheses. No interviews, fieldwork, user experiments, live-service checks, or local-policy verification are claimed.

cases.problem: A total and line items hide the bridge between last month and this month; design hypothesis only, no user study.
cases.source_type: design hypothesis from common information structures; no external dataset or fieldwork
cases.limitations: Amounts are invented USD demonstration values. No tariff, tax rule, or utility provider is represented.
cases.audience: A householder trying to understand an unexpected electricity bill
cases.use_context: A4-style portrait explainer next to a monthly statement

scenario_requirements.condition: The waterfall reconciles exactly from $104 to $142 and labels the $38 total increase.
scenario_requirements.method: Recompute every bar and compare rendered totals with demo_values.

scenario_requirements.condition: Energy +$34, taxes +$3, and credit +$1 are shown with correct signs; unchanged charges are not presented as causes.
scenario_requirements.method: Inspect labels and compare each delta with the two component lists.

scenario_requirements.condition: Every changed component has a plausible question or action, and no unverified cause is stated as fact.
scenario_requirements.method: Read the action rail and confirm it uses check/ask language rather than assertions.

scenario_requirements.condition: All amounts, axis labels, and body text are legible with no bar-label collisions.
scenario_requirements.method: Inspect full PNG, 50% thumbnail, and waterfall-label crops.

cases.user_goal: Identify which charges changed, by how much, and what action or question each change suggests.
cases.reconstruction: 把总价与流水拆成从旧总额到新总额的瀑布，并把每个变化转成下一步问题。
cases.observable_readability_improvement: 最大变化+$34与总额+$38可在同一视觉路径上读出，变化不再隐藏在流水项中。
cases.unverified_effect: No usability test, task-time measurement, recall test, field deployment, or outcome validation was performed.
cases.validation_question: Can a householder name the largest driver and the next useful question without reading the original statement?
cases.final_review: $104+$34+$3+$1=$142与+$38一致；三项变化均有检查/提问动作。标题、总额、横轴标签、行动卡和虚构声明均可读，无遮挡或裁切。

cases.problem: A line diagram shows geography but not service state; a disruption list shows state but not journey consequence. Design hypothesis only.
cases.source_type: design hypothesis from common information structures; no external dataset or fieldwork
cases.limitations: All stations, service states, times, and the replacement bus are fictional. This is not live transit information.
cases.audience: A commuter facing a partial train-line disruption
cases.use_context: Landscape station display and mobile companion view

scenario_requirements.condition: The closed Harbor–Market rail segment, replacement bus, and continuing Market–Museum train are unambiguous.
scenario_requirements.method: Trace the full Harbor-to-Museum path and read every service-state label.

scenario_requirements.condition: The answer to 'Can I still get there?' is visible before detailed disruption information.
scenario_requirements.method: Inspect the top-level journey answer and visual hierarchy.

scenario_requirements.condition: The 12-minute extra time is marked demo and is not presented as a live estimate.
scenario_requirements.method: Inspect the time badge and fictional-demo notice.

scenario_requirements.condition: Station labels remain readable at display distance and no route line crosses text.
scenario_requirements.method: Review full PNG at target distance and crops around the interchange.

cases.user_goal: Determine whether the destination is still reachable, which stations are affected, and where to change or wait.
cases.reconstruction: 把服务状态叠在旅程网络上，用闭合段、替代巴士和换乘箭头表达可达性。
cases.observable_readability_improvement: 目的地可达答案、换乘点和保留服务段同时可见，减少在状态与路线之间来回对照。
cases.unverified_effect: No usability test, task-time measurement, recall test, field deployment, or outcome validation was performed.
cases.validation_question: Can a commuter identify the transfer point and remaining service within a few seconds?
cases.final_review: YES答案先于细节；Harbor–Market闭合、替代巴士、Market换乘和Market–Museum列车形成完整路径；+12分钟明确为虚构估计，站点标签不被线路穿过。

cases.problem: Listings separate rent, utilities, parking, laundry, and deposits, making the recurring total hard to compare. Design hypothesis only.
cases.source_type: design hypothesis from common information structures; no external dataset or fieldwork
cases.limitations: All amounts are fictional USD demonstration values. Utility figures are estimates; entry fees are shown separately and excluded from monthly totals.
cases.audience: A renter comparing listings with different fees and included utilities
cases.use_context: Portrait comparison sheet used during an apartment search

scenario_requirements.condition: Monthly totals are exactly $1,665, $1,610, and $1,810 and each stack reconciles to its components.
scenario_requirements.method: Recompute all three stacks and compare with demo_values.

scenario_requirements.condition: One-time entry fees are visually separated from recurring monthly cost and not silently included.
scenario_requirements.method: Inspect the top/bottom separation and all labels.

scenario_requirements.condition: Estimated utilities are labelled estimates and the lowest monthly total is not framed as an absolute recommendation.
scenario_requirements.method: Read all qualifiers and the decision note.

scenario_requirements.condition: Stack labels align, no amount is clipped, and comparisons remain readable at 50% view.
scenario_requirements.method: Inspect full PNG, thumbnail, and crops around each stack total.

cases.user_goal: Compare complete recurring monthly cost and one-time entry cost instead of headline rent alone.
cases.reconstruction: 用共享零基线的经常性成本堆栈比较完整月费，并把一次性费用移到独立区域。
cases.observable_readability_improvement: 三个月费总额和一次性费用不在同一数量级混排，最低月费可直接排序。
cases.unverified_effect: No usability test, task-time measurement, recall test, field deployment, or outcome validation was performed.
cases.validation_question: Can renters rank total monthly cost without accidentally counting deposits as monthly rent?
cases.final_review: A/B/C月总额分别为$1,665/$1,610/$1,810，三组构成相加准确；一次性$500/$350/$600独立展示。Utilities为估计，C的$140引线标签清楚，最低月费不被表述为绝对推荐。

cases.problem: Pack sizes and promotion labels differ, so shoppers must normalize price and quantity mentally while also considering waste. Design hypothesis only.
cases.source_type: design hypothesis from common information structures; no external dataset or fieldwork
cases.limitations: Product, prices, masses, and expiry days are fictional demonstration values; no nutrition or health claim.
cases.audience: A shopper comparing two pack sizes under time pressure
cases.use_context: Shelf-edge portrait card and phone shopping companion

scenario_requirements.condition: Unit prices are exactly $6.00/kg and $6.60/kg with visible calculation inputs.
scenario_requirements.method: Recompute from mass and price and compare rendered values.

scenario_requirements.condition: The $1.80 higher upfront cost and expiry/waste tradeoff are visible beside the unit-price result.
scenario_requirements.method: Inspect the lower tradeoff band and labels.

scenario_requirements.condition: The piece does not claim the larger pack is always better; it gives a conditional choice.
scenario_requirements.method: Read the decision line and verify no absolute recommendation.

scenario_requirements.condition: Shelf-tag typography, ruler ticks, and tradeoff labels remain readable without overlap.
scenario_requirements.method: Inspect full PNG and crops around the per-kilogram ruler.

cases.user_goal: Compare unit price while seeing upfront cost, likely usable quantity, and expiry/waste risk.
cases.reconstruction: 把不同规格归一化到同一把$/kg尺，同时并列现金差和使用期限。
cases.observable_readability_improvement: 两个单位价在同一标尺上相距$0.60，规格差异不再需要心算。
cases.unverified_effect: No usability test, task-time measurement, recall test, field deployment, or outcome validation was performed.
cases.validation_question: Can shoppers explain why the lower unit price may still be the wrong purchase for their household?

cases.problem: A chronological deadline list hides dependencies and effort, so equal urgency can conceal very different next steps. Design hypothesis only.
cases.source_type: design hypothesis from common information structures; no external dataset or fieldwork
cases.limitations: Course, dates, weights, and effort estimates are fictional. Effort is a planning estimate, not measured productivity.
cases.audience: A university student juggling interdependent assignments
cases.use_context: Portrait study-planning poster and phone companion

scenario_requirements.condition: Outline unlocks draft, draft unlocks peer review, and peer review unlocks final; the path is complete.
scenario_requirements.method: Trace all dependency arrows and compare with demo_values.

scenario_requirements.condition: Dates, weights, and effort estimates are accurate, sum correctly, and are labelled fictional/estimated.
scenario_requirements.method: Recompute 100% and 16 hours and inspect all qualifiers.

scenario_requirements.condition: The recommended next action follows dependency logic and is not simply the task with the largest grade weight.
scenario_requirements.method: Inspect the highlighted start point and explanation.

scenario_requirements.condition: Arrows, gates, dates, and effort labels remain readable with no crossing or clipped text.
scenario_requirements.method: Review full PNG, 50% thumbnail, and crops around each gate.

cases.user_goal: See which assignment unlocks others, estimate effort, and choose a realistic next action before the nearest deadline.
cases.reconstruction: 把截止日列表改为依赖河，先展示解锁下一步的起点，再显示权重与工时。
cases.observable_readability_improvement: 起点由依赖关系而非权重/日期紧迫性决定，四个解锁动作方向一致。
cases.unverified_effect: No usability test, task-time measurement, recall test, field deployment, or outcome validation was performed.
cases.validation_question: Can the student identify the first action and explain how it affects the final deadline?
cases.final_review: Outline→Draft→Peer review→Final依赖完整；Dec 02/05/08/12、20/30/10/40%和3/6/2/5小时准确，总计100%与16小时；START HERE符合依赖逻辑。

cases.problem: Policy wording is organized by legal sections rather than the user's event; exclusions and conditions are hard to connect to a real scenario. Design hypothesis only.
cases.source_type: design hypothesis from common information structures; no external dataset or fieldwork

assumptions.outcome: Needs adjuster review; no coverage decision is claimed.

cases.limitations: Policy language and scenario are fictional and simplified. The artwork must state that it is not legal advice or a real coverage determination.
cases.audience: A policyholder trying to understand a home-insurance scenario before calling support
cases.use_context: Portrait decision guide beside a fictional policy summary

scenario_requirements.condition: The scenario, relevant section, exclusion check, documents, and next step form one traceable path.
scenario_requirements.method: Trace the tree from event to outcome and compare with demo_values.

scenario_requirements.condition: The outcome does not say covered or denied; it says needs adjuster review and explains why.
scenario_requirements.method: Inspect the terminal node and all outcome wording.

scenario_requirements.condition: Fictional-policy and not-legal-advice notices are visible and readable.
scenario_requirements.method: Inspect the top/bottom notices and case metadata.

scenario_requirements.condition: Branches, labels, and checklist items do not overlap or imply missing policy facts.
scenario_requirements.method: Inspect full PNG and crops around every branch and the terminal node.

cases.user_goal: Follow a scenario from event description to relevant policy section, exclusions, documentation, and the next question to ask.
cases.reconstruction: 把用户事件与政策条款并用场景树连接，明确哪些事实仍需理算员判断。
cases.observable_readability_improvement: 应读条款、应查排除项和待补证据在同一路径上分组，未读条款不会被误当成结论。
cases.unverified_effect: No usability test, task-time measurement, recall test, field deployment, or outcome validation was performed.
cases.validation_question: Can a reader identify which exclusion and documents matter without mistaking the guide for a coverage decision?
cases.final_review: 爆管事件连接到Section 4、渐进渗漏排除项、三类证明和需理算员审查；未作赔付/拒赔判断，虚构政策与非法律建议警示显著。

cases.problem: Repair quotes and replacement prices are incomparable without remaining-life and warranty context. Design hypothesis only.
cases.source_type: design hypothesis from common information structures; no external dataset or fieldwork
cases.limitations: All costs and life assumptions are fictional and exclude energy, disposal, installation, and future failures. The result is conditional, not a universal recommendation.
cases.audience: A householder deciding what to do after an appliance failure
cases.use_context: Portrait decision card beside a repair quote

scenario_requirements.condition: Repair and replacement totals, life assumptions, and per-year figures are exact and labelled demo assumptions.
scenario_requirements.method: Recompute $55 and $97.50 and compare all rendered inputs.

scenario_requirements.condition: Warranty status is shown as a decision gate, not buried in fine print.
scenario_requirements.method: Inspect the gate and its connection to both options.

scenario_requirements.condition: Energy, disposal, installation, and future failures are acknowledged as excluded factors; no absolute recommendation appears.
scenario_requirements.method: Read the limitations line and decision wording.

scenario_requirements.condition: Dial arcs, labels, and factors tray are readable with no overlap or misleading scale.
scenario_requirements.method: Inspect full PNG, 50% thumbnail, and crops around both arcs.

cases.user_goal: Compare immediate cost, remaining-life assumptions, warranty status, and non-price factors before choosing a next step.
cases.reconstruction: 把两种价格除以假设寿命并映射到同一比例弧形标尺，同时显示保修门槛和排除因素。
cases.observable_readability_improvement: $55与$97.50可直接比较，且立即看到四年/八年假设并非事实。
cases.unverified_effect: No usability test, task-time measurement, recall test, field deployment, or outcome validation was performed.
cases.validation_question: Can the reader state why repair looks cheaper under these assumptions and what could change that result?
cases.final_review: $220÷4=$55/年，$780÷8=$97.50/年；$0–$120标尺和两档弧长一致，保修过期为前置门槛，能源/处置/安装/未来故障明确排除。

cases.problem: Material symbols and accepted-item lists do not always explain condition, preparation, or special drop-off requirements. Design hypothesis only.
cases.source_type: design hypothesis from common information structures; no external dataset or fieldwork
cases.limitations: Harbor City and every rule are fictional. The artwork must not be used as real local recycling guidance.
cases.audience: A resident unsure how to sort six ambiguous household items

scenario_requirements.condition: All six items have a visible route and preparation instruction matching the fictional rule set.
scenario_requirements.method: Trace each item to its destination and compare with demo_values.

scenario_requirements.condition: Soft plastic bags and batteries route to special drop-off rather than curbside bins.
scenario_requirements.method: Inspect branch destinations and labels.

scenario_requirements.condition: The fictional-city warning is prominent enough that the guide cannot be mistaken for real local policy.
scenario_requirements.method: Inspect title/subtitle, city label, and case metadata.

scenario_requirements.condition: Conveyor paths, item labels, and route destinations remain readable with no crossings or clutter.
scenario_requirements.method: Review full PNG, 50% thumbnail, and crops around each branch.

cases.user_goal: Sort each item by material and condition, identify contamination risks, and find the correct next action for non-curbside items.
cases.reconstruction: 把材料名称列表改为物品→准备动作→去向的六条分类传送带。
cases.observable_readability_improvement: 六件物品的准备与去向一一对应，软袋和电池不会进入普通回收路线。
cases.unverified_effect: No usability test, task-time measurement, recall test, field deployment, or outcome validation was performed.
cases.validation_question: Can residents correctly route the soft bag and battery without assuming all recyclable materials share one bin?
cases.final_review: 六件物品均有准备动作和独立去向；软塑袋到STORE DROP-OFF、电池到BATTERY DROP-OFF；Harbor City规则明确虚构且不可作为现实指导。

cases.problem: Agendas are ordered by procedure and department, not by who is affected or what action residents can take. Design hypothesis only.
cases.source_type: design hypothesis from common information structures; no external dataset or fieldwork

items.impact: drivers and bus riders on 3rd Avenue

cases.limitations: Meeting, district, locations, decisions, and deadlines are fictional. The map is an agenda reordering demonstration, not an official notice.
cases.audience: A resident scanning a long public-meeting agenda
cases.use_context: Landscape civic agenda map before a neighborhood meeting

scenario_requirements.condition: Each agenda item shows the decision, affected group/place, and comment deadline without procedural jargon.
scenario_requirements.method: Read all four cards and compare with demo_values.

scenario_requirements.condition: The map makes impact geography visible without implying exact boundaries or real district data.
scenario_requirements.method: Inspect map labels, impact connections, and demo notice.

scenario_requirements.condition: Participation actions and deadlines are visible, and the artwork does not claim that public comment changes a predetermined outcome.
scenario_requirements.method: Inspect the deadline rail and participation wording.

scenario_requirements.condition: Cards, map labels, and connectors remain readable with no overlap or clipped deadlines.
scenario_requirements.method: Review full PNG, 50% thumbnail, and crops around each card-map connection.

cases.user_goal: Find agenda items by personal impact, understand what decision is being made, and know when and how to comment.
cases.reconstruction: 把议程清单改为地图节点与行动卡联动，按地点、受影响人群和评论截止日重排。
cases.observable_readability_improvement: 每项议程的决定、影响对象和截止日在同一卡片中，地图提供空间索引。
cases.unverified_effect: No usability test, task-time measurement, recall test, field deployment, or outcome validation was performed.
cases.validation_question: Can a resident identify one relevant item and its comment deadline without reading the full procedural agenda?
cases.final_review: 四项议程均显示地点/受影响人群、决定和Dec 01/03/04/05评论截止日；地图标为示意边界，参与说明不承诺结果改变，底部卡片已离开页脚线。

cases.problem: Router status pages report house-level connection health while users experience room-level dead zones. Design hypothesis only.
cases.source_type: design hypothesis from common information structures; no external dataset or fieldwork

actions: move router higher and away from the microwave
test kitchen again in the same spot
add a mesh point only if the test still fails

cases.limitations: Floor plan, signal values in dBm, device locations, and actions are fictional. The guide must not claim a guaranteed fix or a measured survey.
cases.audience: A householder troubleshooting weak Wi-Fi in one room

scenario_requirements.condition: Router location, three demo signal readings, and the kitchen test point are visible and correctly associated.
scenario_requirements.method: Inspect each room label and compare with demo_values.

scenario_requirements.condition: The action sequence tests one change before recommending a mesh point, avoiding an immediate upsell.
scenario_requirements.method: Trace the three-step rail and inspect conditional wording.

scenario_requirements.condition: Signal contours and dBm values are labelled fictional demonstration data, not a measured or guaranteed diagnosis.
scenario_requirements.method: Inspect the legend, demo notice, and limitation copy.

scenario_requirements.condition: Contours do not obscure room labels or action text, and the floor plan remains readable at 50%.
scenario_requirements.method: Review full PNG, thumbnail, and crops around the kitchen test point.

cases.user_goal: Locate the likely weak-signal area, test one change at a time, and choose a proportionate next action.
cases.reconstruction: 把覆盖全屋的建议改为房间户型诊断，用读数、测试点和单变量步骤限制决策范围。
cases.observable_readability_improvement: 弱点在Kitchen定位，行动从调整路由器开始，而非直接升级全屋设备。
cases.unverified_effect: No usability test, task-time measurement, recall test, field deployment, or outcome validation was performed.
cases.validation_question: Can the householder identify the next test and avoid buying hardware before checking router placement?
cases.final_review: 路由器、Living room−42、Bedroom−58、Kitchen−72 dBm与厨房测试点关联正确；先移动再重复测试再考虑Mesh，圈层不越界，虚构读数与无保证说明可见。
